Mod.Name: Precision Pipettes
Mod.Author: NyanDoggo
Mod.Description: Adds 0.5 ml and 0.1 ml droppers for doses smaller than the vanilla 1 ml one. They work exactly like the vanilla droppers (draw when empty, drop it all when full), show their volume in fractions of a ml, and have a green (0.5 ml) or red (0.1 ml) bulb so you can tell them apart from the teal 1 ml and purple 5 ml. The Retired Chemist sells both whenever they offer the 1 ml dropper.
